# Workflows

Five workflows, all run by hand (Actions → pick one → **Run workflow**):

| Workflow | For |
|---|---|
| `1-check.yml` — **1 · Check** | is this branch healthy (quick or thorough; GitHub's machines or my Linux machine) |
| `2-devices.yml` — **2 · Devices** | my machines, a phone on USB, the phone farm |
| `3-build.yml` — **3 · Build** | installable builds per platform, as artifacts |
| `4-release.yml` — **4 · Release** | rehearse, gate and build, or publish (after approval) |
| `5-housekeeping.yml` — **5 · Housekeeping** | refresh goldens and reference models |

The files starting with `_` are engines with no Run button: `_plan.yml`
(reads the form and the projects' `ci.toml` files), `_job.yml` (runs the
planned jobs, generated by `ci/lib/make_engine.py`) and `_results.yml`
(files every run on the `ci-results` branch).

**What runs is not in this folder.** Each project's `ci.toml` and its
`ci/jobs/*.toml` say what CI runs for it; [`ci/README.md`](../../ci/README.md)
explains the files, how to add a crate or an app, the machines and the
secrets.

## Where the old workflows went

Every job of the old Cloud VM / Device parts is now a job file in the
project it checks, with its steps unchanged:

| Before | Now (project · job) | Run from |
|---|---|---|
| cloud-machines-quick | vieww · quick, workflows; wright · sandbox-quick | Check (quick) |
| shared-framework-checks | vieww · framework-*; vieww-audio · framework-audio-fuzz; vieww · usb-phone | Check (gate quick, rest thorough); Devices |
| cloud-machines-studio | viewwstudio · suite | Check (thorough) |
| cloud-machines-wright-sandbox / -models | wright · sandbox-*, models-* | Check (thorough) |
| cloud-machines-wright-installers | wright · installers, installers-release, update-channel-tests | Build; Release; Check |
| cloud-machines-audio-ci / -backends / -plugins, cloud-mobile-audio | vieww-audio · test, fuzz, backends-*, mobile-*; vieww-audio-plugin · plugins | Check |
| cloud-machines-goldens | vieww · goldens, goldens-refresh | Check (thorough); Housekeeping |
| cloud-machines-publish | vieww · crates-check, -verify, -scaffold-external, -publish | Release |
| cloud-machines-supply-chain | vieww · advisories, sbom, repro | Check (thorough); Release |
| cloud-mobile-apps | the mobile-app kind's android / ios, for vavlt, snapsearch, three, upxcale | Build; Check (thorough) |
| cloud-mobile-u-apk / -u-models | U · apk, models | Build; Housekeeping |
| device-machines-feature | vieww / wright / viewwstudio / wright-flow · machine | Check on "My Linux machine" |
| device-machines-hardware | vieww · hardware-linux, -windows, -macos, hardware-report | Devices |
| device-mobile-phone-farm | U · farm-apk, farm-ipa, farm-phones, farm-iphones, farm-report | Devices |
| shared-release-gate | vieww · gate (legs from `ci/jobs/gate-legs.py`), gate-checklist, gate-release | Release |
| shared-results | `_results.yml` | every run's last job |
| cloud-vm, device, `.github/entry/plan.py` | the five workflows and `ci/projects plan` | — |

Gone: the Cloud VM / Device item checkboxes and the `steps` text field
(each workflow's form replaces them), the root ↔ `vieww_base/.github`
wire check (that copy is removed), and the mobile and feature-run summary
jobs (the plan's summary table and `_results` cover them). New: site
builds and Cloudflare Pages deploys, a default check and build for any
project of a kind, phone farm tiers, and approval before publishing.

`feature_branch_variants/` keeps reference copies from the old
`feature/main_fixes` branch; GitHub does not read subfolders.
